description: This file defines a static class ChatFormat responsible for formatting and manipulating chat XML documents, including initializing documents, retrieving posts, creating new posts, finding specific posts, replacing post text, and enforcing a maximum number of posts.

classes.name: ChatFormat
classes.description: A static class that provides methods for initializing, reading, modifying, and enforcing limits on a chat XML document schema.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the XML document with a creation comment and root structure if it is empty.

methods.name: GetPostsContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the container element that holds all posts within the document.

methods.name: MakePost
methods.description: Creates a new XElement representing a chat post with specified GUID, user, timestamp, and text.

methods.name: FindPost
methods.description: Finds a post element within the document by its GUID.

methods.name: ReplaceText
methods.description: Replaces the text content of a post element.

methods.name: EnforceLimit
methods.description: Removes the oldest post if the number of posts exceeds MaxNumPosts.
